newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were little changed in featureless trade, dealers said on Tuesday.

They said most traders were sidelined ahead of tonight's 1330 GMT release of the U.S. October housing starts data, which is forecast to be around 1.443 million units compared with 1.438 million units reported in September.

"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning due mainly to an absence of fresh incentives. Some people are waiting for tonight's release of the housing starts figures for more clues to market direction," a local dealer said.
"But I don't think there will be much impact unless the numbers are way off market expectations," he said.
In day-to-day rates, Tuesday/Wednesday, Wednesday/Thursday and week-fixed were unchanged from Monday's common 5-3/8 5-1/4 percent, respectively.
Among longer dates, two-months was unchanged at 5-1/2 5-3/8 percent, four-months unchanged at 5-1/2 5-3/8, six-months unchanged at 5-9/16 5-7/16 and twelve-months unchanged at 5-11/16 5-9/16 percent.
